575:t_007:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Who brought $$ガイオウ$$ into $$インサラウム$$!?」

575:t_007:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「It's no use expecting an answer... They're rejecting us completely.」

575:t_007:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They seek to crush our hearts with terror...」

575:t_007:5.en:
$$キリコ$$
「They are the future of despair itself...」

575:t_007:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Now's no time to talk about outsiders interfering! We've got to fight!」

575:t_007:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah...! If $$サイデリアル$$ is involved in $$インサラウム$$'s destruction, we can't just let it happen!」

575:t_007:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I will present the combat analysis results. Our probability of victory is...」

575:t_007:12.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We don't need to hear it.」

575:t_007:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「We have no choice but to win!」

575:t_007:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「If we don't, Earth in this world will be destroyed!」

575:t_007:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, begin your attack! Remember, $$インサラウム$$'s future depends on this battle!」

575:t_007:16.en:
$$セツコ$$
「They are the fundamental calamity... the ones standing in the way of humanity's future...」

575:t_007:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「I get it now. They're... the enemy of all living things!」

575:t_008:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Damn it...! Our attacks barely work on them...」

575:t_008:2.en:
$n
「Is this... $$サイデリアル$$'s true power...?」

575:t_008:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Their main forces are in the galactic center, yes. But even $$チェインバー#pilot$$ had no data on those black $$アンゲロイ$$.」

575:t_008:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Are they unrelated to $$サイデリアル$$?」

575:t_008:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's possible, since they aren't stationed at the Emperor's stronghold, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

575:t_008:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It looks like this isn't over yet.」

575:t_009:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Damn it...! Our attacks barely work on them!」

575:t_009:2.en:
$n
「Is this... $$サイデリアル$$'s true power...!?」

575:t_009:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Their main forces are in the galactic center, yes. But even $$チェインバー#pilot$$ had no data on those black $$アンゲロイ$$.」

575:t_009:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Are they unrelated to $$サイデリアル$$!?」

575:t_009:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's possible, since they aren't stationed at the Emperor's stronghold, $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

575:t_009:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It looks like they're dead serious about this!」

575:t_010:0.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「There are still that many enemies...!」

575:t_010:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The distortion in the dimensional boundary is rapidly increasing!」

575:t_011:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「The black $$アンゲロイ$$ were taken out!」

575:t_011:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you've damn well shown up...」

575:t_012:1.en:
$$くらら$$
「It seems he hadn't lost his memory.」

575:t_012:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Those black $$アンゲロイ$$ seem to have been involved in $$ガイオウ$$'s memory loss, too.」

575:t_012:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I don't really understand, but we've protected this world's $$インサラウム$$ now, haven't we?」

575:t_012:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A parallel world where the $$破界の王$$ never appears was probably born at this very moment.」

575:t_012:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「So from here on, they'll create their own future with their own hands...」

575:t_012:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「And that wraps up this case...!」

575:t_012:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Is this any time to say that!? We still don't know if we can get home!」

575:t_012:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We don't have to worry about that.」

575:t_013:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Is it because $$ガイオウ$$ came here!? Or did those black bastards do it!?」

575:t_013:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I'm sure it's because my wish came true.」

575:t_013:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「We can get back to our world!」

575:t_014:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$次元将$$ $$ヴァイシュラバ$$... He'll probably go on fighting the fundamental calamity in his own way...)

575:t_014:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(So long, $$破界の王$$ $$ガイオウ$$... Sorry, $$カルロス$$, but the name $$ヴァイシュラバ$$ suits you better...)

575:t_014:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
(And this is goodbye... Long live the Holy Kingdom... or something like that.)

575:t_015:0.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「...It seems the invaders from another world have already left.」

575:t_015:1.en:
$$ウェイン$$
「So the garrison put their lives on the line and did it.」

575:t_015:2.en:
$$シュバル$$
「But we mustn't let our guard down. We don't know when that person might return.」

575:t_015:3.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「The invader the garrison encountered piloted a white machine. They said they sensed an extraordinary aura from that person.」

575:t_015:4.en:
$$ジェラウド$$
「They appear by breaking through worlds... So they are the $$破界の王$$...」

575:t_015:5.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「If that white figure appears again, we $$ハイナイト$$s will deal with them.」

575:t_015:6.en:
$$ジェラウド$$
「That's right. Protecting $$インサラウム$$'s future is the duty of the $$アークセイバー$$s.」

575:t_100:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(If we don't hurry, he'll show up...!)

575:t_100:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I'd rather deal with these black $$アンゲロイ$$ than fight that bastard again!)

575:t_101:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
($$ノノ$$... I'm... not your Big Sis... I'm.........)

575:t_101:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Damn it...! I have to focus on the enemies in front of me now!」

575:t_102:0.en:
$n
(If we were transported because $$クロウ$$ wished to come to $$インサラウム$$, then what am I...?)

580:t_1:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I never imagined $$クロウ$$'s wish would transport $c...」

580:t_1:5.en:
$$桂$$
「The situation back then was completely insane.」

580:t_1:6.en:
$$桂$$
「That sense of everyone's feelings swirling around was like the space-time repair during the $$多元戦争$$, but the chaos was unbelievable.」

580:t_1:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「The distortion in the dimensional boundary seems stable now, but we don't know what might happen next, or when.」
